Backend Engineer (Node.js)
Basketry

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

Basketry is a grocery marketplace for neighborhood stores in Dhaka, Karachi and Jakarta. Shoppers order on our app and local stores pack and deliver within the hour.

You will join the orders team and build the services behind checkout, store inventory and delivery tracking.

What you will do
- Build backend services in Node.js and TypeScript.
- Design our public GraphQL API and the REST APIs for store tablets.
- Model orders and inventory in PostgreSQL; cache hot paths in Redis.
- Run background jobs for order timeouts and refunds.
- Ship with Docker on AWS, through GitHub Actions.

What you need
- 3+ years of backend development.
- Node.js and TypeScript.
- PostgreSQL and Redis.
- GraphQL.
- Experience with AWS.

Nice to have
- Experience with Python or Go.
- Marketplace or e-commerce experience.
- Experience with payments.

Salary: $45,000 to $65,000 USD. Remote within Asia.
